about_the_game:
You will pilot mechanical constructs, utilizing your own unique combat techniques, to face off against the legendary mages of the eight schools in a fated showdown.

Core Features:

Evolving Combat Skills

Battle against skill masters to continuously learn new combat abilities and enrich your tactical options. Combine hundreds of combat styles and dominate the battlefield with your unique approach.

Strategy-Intensive Combat

Randomly loot weapons, equipment, and magical scrolls from enemies during combat. Wield them to unleash wondrous and unpredictable effects. Unlock hidden storylines and endgame content by gradually uncovering the world’s secrets.

Mage’s Workshop

The legendary mages—your enemies—are entrenched in their laboratories, researching the ultimate magic of their respective schools. You must navigate branching paths to find the one true route to confront and defeat them.

Epic Showdowns with Eight Legendary Mages

Face off against uniquely styled bosses: the “Pyre Overlord,” who manipulates lava and reshapes terrain; the “Chronoweaver,” who reverses time and replicates your skills; the “Shadowweaver,” who slips into shadow dimensions and creates illusions—and more. Each battle incorporates interactive environmental mechanics, testing both strategy and quick reflexes.

Fantastical Vehicles

Pilot mechanical colossi, ride atop dragons, and become a Dragon Knight. Crush all who stand in your way!

  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070

short_description: 《Sanctum Mage》is a magic-fantasy roguelite action-adventure game. you will: forge dynamic combat strategies, combine randomly empowered arcane blessings, and pilot enchanted war machines to break through swarms of foes.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Korean
